ModMetaData.name: Mandrake Mine Shaft
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
A mine shaft: a work site where a miner works the ore veins this map actually holds, one bill at a time. Our own replacement for Mines 2.0 (Cain.Mineshaft), written to the 2026-10-11 assessment (design/RimMandrake/mines_mod_assessment_20261011.md). No dependency on any other mod.
At startup one "Mine for X" bill is made for every mineable resource rock (and, if enabled, every natural stone). A bill is offered only on maps that hold that vein, as rock still standing on the map or as a deep deposit, so gold and gems stay where their home biome put them. Products named by any MineShaftPolicyDef are never offered: the shipped policy bars manufactured parts (components); other mods add their own policy defs.
Mod Settings ("Mine Shaft"): shaft bills on or off, only the veins this map holds, stone chunk bills, yield and work multipliers.
Art: a vanilla deep-drill texture stands in until the shaft's own sprite lands.
